view_title: ประตู 1, 2, 3, 4; หน้าต่าง 1, 2
warnings: Marks are printed as a bare number: in a circle for doors (1-4) and in a hexagon for windows (1-2). The A-01 symbol legend defines these bubbles as D1 = แสดงหมายเลข ประตู and W1 = แสดงหมายเลข หน้าต่าง, so element_id uses that D/W prefix (door 1 and window 1 would otherwise collide on one sheet, section 0.3) and the bare printed number is kept in element_id_printed_as.

Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Widths: where two widths are printed the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m); D1 is a double leaf 0.70 + 0.70. Door heights 2.05 to ระดับพื้นห้อง; W1 sill 0.85 + 1.10 = head 2.05, W2 sill 1.60 + 0.45 = head 2.15.
